summary: Destructor-teardown helper (__thiscall): saves the child/payload pointer stored at dword index 1043 (byte offset 0x104C) of the object, replaces the object vtable pointer at offset 0x0 with the static table off_5ADB80, then frees the saved child pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf and returns that function's result. No guard - every statement always executes.

operations.description: Load the child/payload pointer from dword index this[1043] (byte offset this+0x104C) into a local before the vtable is replaced.
Overwrite the object vtable pointer at offset this+0x0 with the static vtable address off_5ADB80.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the saved child/payload pointer to release the owned child object.
Return the result of the FreeWrapper_7bcf call.
Invoked as a teardown step by ComplexDestructorWithLoop (0x00506FD9), ShortComputation_76e2 (0x005076E2) and DestructorWithResourceCleanup_b830 (0x0050B830).

unresolved: Exact class and ownership semantics of the child object stored at this[1043] are unknown.
FreeWrapper_7bcf release semantics (plain free vs. pooled/aware deallocation) are unknown here.
The field reference 0x104C corresponds to the raw source's dword index this[1043] (1043 * 4).
